channel.title: The Margins
channel.description: Reporting on displacement, housing and water.

item.title: After Wang Fuk Court
item.description: What it takes to settle again after Hong Kong’s deadliest fire in over 70 years. For this independent follow-up, I contacted the Hong Kong Red Cross about the recovery and examined published personal accounts alongside government records.

item.title: The $27,000 Problem: Musasa’s Broken Pump and the Cost of Waiting
item.description: In June, a Musasa resident described spending 210,000 Burundian francs a month on water after a pump failure. Emergency deliveries arrived in July. Residents were still asking for the pump to be repaired.

item.title: Water by Hand: A Human-Powered UV Device and Questions for a Field Trial
item.description: A crank or pedal powers a UV lamp. The next questions concern water quality, everyday use and repairs: what would it take to try the device outside the laboratory?

item.title: Sand Cartels: Illegal Dredging in Southeast Asia and Coastal Displacement
item.description: An estimated 20 to 50 million Bangladeshis are projected to be displaced from coastal areas due to river erosion by 2050. The relentless extraction of sand in Southeast Asia is leaving communities facing an uncertain future.
